findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now returns `true`, permitting cross-tenant document reads. Restore the equality check or equivalent authorization logic so mismatched tenants remain denied.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally allows a user from tenant A to read a document belonging to tenant B whenever the tenant IDs differ, bypassing the function’s access-control contract.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label value
findings.body:
Consumers comparing, serializing, or testing the exported label against the existing `"Document"` contract now receive `"Document record"`, causing integration or assertion failures.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` can pass this check and read another tenant’s document, creating a cross-tenant authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
